title: fix(review-agent): inspect the app's own scripts when CDN scripts come first
author: lotxo1

gist.summary: Fixed app pre-review inspection so three CDN scripts cannot use up the script-check limit before the reviewer reaches an app’s own code. The reviewer now skips other-origin scripts first, then inspects up to three same-origin scripts for Pollinations integration. Added a regression test with three cdnjs scripts followed by an app.js that calls gen.pollinations.ai.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli, the main character, is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings. She is small-to-medium in the scene, wears tiny inspector glasses, and helps a chunky CRT monitor robot look past three labeled CDN scrolls to an app.js scroll sprouting a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with a warm cream background and dark purple (#110518) outlines.
